evidence.statement: One deterministic evaluator (lib/modeling/scorecard/scorecardEvaluator.ts) + thin CLI (scripts/modeling/scorecard-run.ts) produces modeling/evidence/rich-model-scorecard-v1/SCORECARD_7d14d30d_2026-09-02.json with every Model(C0/C1/C4/C5) x Population(SEP_PUBLIC_RICH_V1, SEP_SHADOW_STRATEGIC_V1) x Period(7d/14d/30d) cell: primary economics (N, W/L/V, PnL_u, ROI%, MaxDD_u, PnL per 100 bets), 7-day chronological stability buckets (+/- bucket counts, cumulative PnL, burst concentration), full DATA QUALITY block, and the fixed Score LEVEL diagnostic buckets. Byte-identical across runs and reversed partition input order; SCORECARD_CANONICAL_CONTENT_SHA256=72da11e6bb5302fde75b0cd26ad8c8256cb95181e07057b7835f3cd8207dd32f.

The scorecard yields the model-decision input the mission asked for: only C0/C5 on SEP_PUBLIC_RICH_V1 are positive (30d +168.04u / +28.48% ROI, N=590), but 7-day cumulative PnL [-14.33, -14.33, -15.33, +132.46, +167.67] and burst_concentration 0.75 show the entire result is the single week 2026-08-25..2026-09-01. C1 (soccer) has N<=48 in any cell. C4 is negative wherever it has data. SEP_SHADOW_STRATEGIC_V1 is net-negative for C0/C4/C5. This is sufficient to pick 2-3 forward-validation candidates next; no winner is chosen here.

C0/C1/C4/C5 predicates and the flat-1u settlement / ROI / chronological MaxDD primitives are imported verbatim from lib/modeling/research-engine (engine-version freeze-v1) via runResearchEngine/settleBetU/maxDrawdownU/round — not rewritten. Tests assert WIN pnl_u = 1/entry_price - 1, LOSS = -1, and one-physical-event-one-bet chronological-first selection.

Rolling-reader change is the minimum verbatim carry-through: entryPrice, eventStart, providerSportFamily added to RollingCompactRow/ScorecardReadyRow and mapped straight from the immutable ForwardRichResearchRow in loadPartition. Reuses the existing collapseWindowRows identity/collapse; no new abstraction layer; buildRollingManifest output unchanged for identical inputs.

Score SERIES is never a predicate: SCORE_SERIES_USED_AS_PREDICATE=false; DATA_QUALITY.SCORE_SERIES.STATUS=DATA_QUALITY_ONLY (0% coverage both populations); a test with a populated score series confirms model selection is unchanged. Structural Score LEVEL null stays a 'null' diagnostic bucket, never bucketed as 0. Populations never pooled (6 cells = 3 periods x 2 populations; POPULATION_POOLING=FORBIDDEN). AUG_SHADOW_C4_V1 not introduced.

No threshold search / no Kelly / flat 1u only; Score LEVEL buckets (null / <55 / 55-59 / 60-64 / 65-69 / 70-74 / 75+) are pre-declared and emitted as descriptive diagnostics (SETTLED N, W/L/V, PnL, ROI, MaxDD) — not candidate thresholds. Output is explicitly EVALUATION_MODE=BACKWARD_LOOKING_DESCRIPTIVE, FORWARD_VALIDATED=false, with a disclaimer that no cell is a forward-performance claim.

No DB / clone / production access (DB_READS=0, BROAD_SCANS=0); no rematerialization; canonical immutable partitions and the rolling 7d/14d/30d manifest artifacts have zero git diff. Every reported count states UNIT / SOURCE_STAGE; exclusion counts (OPEN/NO_MATCH/VOID/UNRESOLVED_PHYSICAL_EVENT/MISSING_EVENT_START) are reported per cell.
